overview.zh: 除人形机器人和手部组件外，傅利叶的康复机器人业务还包括与运动测量系统组合的研发与训练平台。官方康复册将Galileo描述为运动平台、跑台、测力、动作捕捉和软件的集成环境，并单独标明与ArmMotus EMU、ExoMotus M4的组合；这些平台、组件和机器人不应合并为一个整机型号。
overview.en: Alongside humanoids and hand components, Fourier offers rehabilitation robotics and integrated movement-measurement platforms for research and training. Its rehabilitation brochure describes Galileo as a motion-base, treadmill, force-sensing, motion-capture and software environment, with separately identified ArmMotus EMU and ExoMotus M4 integrations. The platform, subsystems and robots are not one whole-body robot model.
